title: Friendship: Mara's sheet says what the next heart brings
about: QA round ("hearts are too easy and give little"). Spring 9 at noon, facing Mara at the counter, just short of her first heart, a daffodil (loved) and a parsnip in the bag. Talk: the sheet reads "Next heart: a letter" under her line, and the bar fills toward 100 points. Give the daffodil: one heart, and the next line names a 5% discount, a recipe and a scene. The note beside Gift says the week takes two.
